chunks.rationale: The T3 flat-sidebar rewrite folded Delegating into the working tone, so it painted blue like Working. Restore a distinct 'delegating' tone on StatusLabelInfo and return it from the isDelegating branch. statusDotFor's tone is untouched: it is no longer used for colour, only for label/flags.
risks: data-dim previously keyed off tone === 'working'; delegating rows would have stopped dimming when unselected, so the check now covers both tones.

chunks.rationale: Adds --violet (#a78bfa, the pre-rewrite .badgeDelegating hue) and a .statusLabel[data-tone="delegating"] rule. Waiting/Stalled/Quota/Woke stay amber because they shared amber before the rewrite too.
risks: Violet on --card is ~5.4:1, in line with the other tones; no other consumer of --violet yet.
No test asserts data-tone anywhere, so the colour split is only covered by the existing 'Delegating' text assertions.
